interpretations: List the 10 patients in `Patient` who have at least one `Laboratory` record where both `U-PRO` and `RA` equal `'-'`, reporting each patient’s ID and sex and the unrounded averages of nonmissing `ALP` and `HCT` across all their laboratory records, grouped by ID and sex and ordered by average `HCT` descending with missing averages last.
queries:
SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP,
    AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS qualifying
    WHERE qualifying.ID = p.ID
      AND qualifying."U-PRO" = '-'
      AND qualifying.RA = '-'
)
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
ORDER BY avg_HCT IS NULL, avg_HCT DESC
LIMIT 10
